feature.title: Subprofile dzieci: udostępnianie gier, harmonogram i czas gry
feature.objective: Julia jest własnym profilem MoonWaker używającym Windows i biblioteki Basi; Basia ręcznie nadaje jej dostęp do konkretnych gier, a host egzekwuje harmonogram i czas.
definition_of_done: Dziecko tworzone/edytowane przez autoryzowanego rodzica, kafel zgodny ze zwykłym profilem.
Dziecko widzi wyłącznie gry jawnie udostępnione przez rodzica; pozostałe są ukryte i niemożliwe do odczytu ani uruchomienia przez każdy wspierany endpoint.
Rodzic może z panelu kafelka gry atomowo nadać dostęp wybranym własnym dzieciom albo odebrać go wszystkim/wybranym; nowe dziecko zaczyna bez gier.
Dni, okna i dzienny budżet egzekwowane na hoście, wspólne dla urządzeń tego hosta.
Po czasie właściwa gra zamknięta, stream przerwany, profil MoonWaker wylogowany; nie Windows rodzica.
Przerwy po wyjściu/końcu gry nie zużywają budżetu; progi60/30/15/10/5/1min i saldo na kafelku.
Awaria/restart nie zeruje wykorzystania i nie daje obejścia; obce procesy/sesje zachowane.
Automatyczna i rzeczywista akceptacja zakończona, dowody zapisane.

capability.enable_condition: Pełna akceptacja CP-07 oraz review root.

sources_of_truth.profile_definitions_policy: Existing machine profile registry, one authorized writer; child records reference parent
sources_of_truth.daily_usage_and_reservations: Host-owned child-control usage with Gateway checkpoint30s and clean stop; strict reservations superseded
sources_of_truth.child_game_access: Child record allowed_game_keys in the existing profile registry; Gateway resolves stable canonical provider/game IDs and applies one host policy gate
sources_of_truth.android_selection_presentation: Existing HostGatewayStore keyed by actor profile; no durable budget
sources_of_truth.supervision: Existing Bridge background loop and profile supervisor/restart with persisted child-session lease120s; no own balance or independent worker

invariants: No Windows logoff, no child Windows credentials/SID clone/Bridge instance.
Actor child identity remains through authorization/cache/request/transition; execution parent resolved server-side.
Child use_profile never grants parent use_profile; remote_sign_in requires explicit child grant.
Child UI/cache exposes only the parent's games present in allowed_game_keys; no unfiltered parent catalog or desktop/launcher bypass.
Child grants are scoped to the owning parent and canonical game key; read/start/resume/alias checks cannot be bypassed by a foreign child ID or stale alias.
Grant/revoke selection is all-or-nothing for one game and the parent's own children; a revoked active game follows the proposed immediate cutoff while preserving already used time.
No duplicate GameOps journal or stream transition state machine; no Moonlight core change.
Stop effects target only exact session processes; broad hard_reset_session forbidden for quota expiry.
An orphan child after parent deletion is denied at runtime; cascade delete is not required, and child edit/cleanup belongs to CP-04.
Security scope is minimal for a home-network app: reuse existing pairing and parent PIN; do not add enterprise security, generic auth/IPC frameworks or hypothetical threat checklists.
Cannot mark implementation done from design docs or unit tests alone.

decisions.decision: Julia ma własny kafel i używa Windows oraz biblioteki Basi.
Wylogowanie dotyczy MoonWaker, nie Windows; wspólne zapisy/osiągnięcia jawne w kreatorze.
Dwa konteksty actor/execution; osobny grant dziecka i świeży PIN rodzica do zarządzania.
Próg inkluzywny minimum_age<=max_age; unknown ukryte, jawne PEGI i ocena rodzica w v1.
decisions.rationale: Superseded by the user's manual game-sharing decision; retained as historical design context.

decisions.decision: Per-day enabled/window/daily quota; czas nie płynie po logout/game close.
Jedno okno dziennie, bez rollover; strefa hosta, elapsed monotoniczny; teraz=min(saldo, koniec okna).
Trwałe rezerwacje max5s przed zezwoleniem, refundacja na czystym końcu, max5s nadliczenia po crash.
decisions.rationale: Historical strict enforcement proposal; superseded by the user's accepted emergency tolerance up to 300s.

decisions.decision: Heartbeat5s, timeout15s, lokalny hostowy strażnik zezwolenia niezależny od żywotności Gateway.
decisions.rationale: Historical strict watchdog proposal; superseded by the user's accepted emergency tolerance up to 300s.

decisions.decision: Na deadline odcięcie dostępu; graceful10s potem exact-process force, brak Windows logoff.
decisions.rationale: Satisfies requested game close without broad profile hard reset

decisions.decision: Toasty60/30/15/10/5/1min oraz dostępny czas pod profilem.
V1 wyklucza pulpit/otwarte launchery, install/uninstall, Discord/VirtualHere i retained paused game dziecka.
decisions.rationale: Shared Windows must not expose unrestricted parent paths

decisions.decision: Jeden aktywny child i jeden execution profile; budżet wspólny dla TV tego hosta, bez cross-host sync.
decisions.rationale: Avoid double spending and parent game takeover

decisions.decision: Wąski kanał zapisu przez właściciela rejestru dla kreatora TV; manage_children i krótka sesja PIN.
decisions.rationale: Explicit extension of current elevated Host Control-only management

decisions.decision: Feature capability dopiero po kompletnym enforcement; starsze klienty/hosty nie obsługują dzieci.
Rodzic ręcznie nadaje i odbiera dostęp do gier w panelu kafelka przez multiselect własnych dzieci; oceny wiekowe nie są wymagane.
decisions.rationale: User request to replace difficult rating retrieval with explicit per-game sharing; supersedes CD-04.

decisions.decision: Zakres zabezpieczeń jest minimalny dla domowej aplikacji w domowej sieci: używamy istniejącego parowania i PIN-u rodzica, bez enterprise security, ogólnych nowych frameworków auth/IPC i hipotetycznych threat checklist.
decisions.rationale: User preference; existing TLS/pinning remains unchanged, while child access/quota enforcement, MoonWaker not automatically switching a child to an adult profile, the existing authorized Windows-parent sign-in path and exact-game stop remain functional requirements.

decisions.decision: Przy awarii dopuszczalna jest tolerancja do 300 s; zwykły istniejący nadzór hosta i okresowe checkpointy wystarczają, a konkretną częstotliwość nie większą niż 300 s wybierze CP-03. Restart nie zeruje całodziennego usage, a plan, czas końca i exact own-session stop pozostają wymagane.
decisions.rationale: User preference for a simple home-network behavior; supersedes strict reservation, crash-overcount and independent-heartbeat-watchdog proposals.

decisions.decision: Zamrożone POST API dzieci to /api/v1/profiles/children/{authorize,list,create,update,delete,sharing/get,sharing/set}; mutacje używają parent_profile_id, expected_revision, request_id i istniejącego profile-session header, authorize używa pin, create opcjonalnie grant_current_device=false, a remote_sign_in pozostaje jawną akcją HostControl.
decisions.rationale: Root accepted CP-04 integration contract; manual sharing, no ratings, empty new-child library and 300s failure tolerance remain unchanged.

verified_baseline.finding: Historical baseline: current profile ID drives both authorization and Bridge selection; library proxy currently returns pages without child sharing/grant policy. Child actor/execution separation and the grant gate remain unimplemented.
Historical baseline: inspected DTO has no rating/minimum_age fields; provider metadata/capability and playtime exist. Manual grants make rating fields unnecessary for this feature.
Pins HostProfileKey and profileId; cannot replace child ID with parent ID globally.
Existing HostProfileKey cache seam can isolate child projection.
Exact-process checks available; hard reset iterates profile inventory and is too broad for quota expiry.
Existing registry/PIN management ownership must be retained.

audits.title: Audyt odcięcia streamu i strażnika po awarii Gateway/Bridge
audits.objective: Sprawdzić istniejące możliwości odcięcia właściwego streamu oraz działania strażnika/IPC, gdy Gateway albo Bridge jest niedostępny.
non_goals: No CP-03 implementation or production changes.

audits.summary: Read-only analysis completed. The audit recorded a stricter historical direction using the existing Profile Bridge supervisor, a Gateway-owned permit, exact-process identity and targeted Vibepollo UUID disconnect, but that direction is superseded for active scope by CD-17's accepted tolerance up to 300s with ordinary host supervision and periodic checkpoints. No service, endpoint, process or runtime test was run; no permit/watchdog was implemented; Gateway-client to Vibepollo-UUID binding is not currently durable. Targeted stream-disconnect semantics and Windows/TV failure behavior remain for CP-07 acceptance. Independent review also found manage_children loss during remote-sign-in/legacy-grant changes and missing resolved-parent validation in CreateChildProfile; corrections were verified in diff and regressions, while runtime acceptance remains pending.
findings: Use the existing Profile Bridge supervisor and one Gateway-owned atomic short permit; do not add a second budget owner.
Reuse the existing exact-process PID/path/start/SID/session helper outside a live Bridge where needed.
Use targeted Vibepollo /api/clients/disconnect by UUID; no durable Gateway-client to Vibepollo-UUID assignment exists today.
Do not use global close-app, hard_reset, or Stop-Components paths.
The supervisor main loop can block on health/restart; use a small independent worker launched by the existing supervisor, without a new service or second balance.
The worker may reuse one-shot VibepolloTransport and profile DPAPI credential through stdin, including targeted disconnect after VibepolloBridge death.
Paid permit max5s and heartbeat liveness max15s are separate; cutoff is the minimum of paid permit, liveness, schedule and budget, with no free10s after Gateway crash.
No permit/watchdog implementation or runtime evidence was produced by this audit; targeted API semantics remain unconfirmed.

review_findings.finding: Changing remote sign-in or legacy grant UI could lose manage_children; the correction was verified in diff and regressions. Windows/TV runtime remains pending.
CreateChildProfile must validate the resolved Windows parent; the correction was verified in diff and regressions. Windows/TV runtime remains pending.

known_risks.risk: Ręczne granty mogą pozostawić dziecko z pustą lub niepełną biblioteką, jeśli rodzic nie udostępni gry.

known_risks.risk: Shared Windows is not a security sandbox against local users or independent Sunshine clients.
known_risks.mitigation: State bounded MoonWaker guarantee, prohibit exposed desktop/launcher, require host stream cutoff.

known_risks.risk: Existing per-profile hard reset may kill parent's games.
known_risks.mitigation: Separate exact-session process stop; negative stale/PID-reuse tests.

known_risks.risk: Clock changes/restarts/concurrent devices could reset or overspend quota.
known_risks.mitigation: Gateway checkpoints around 30–60 s, clean stop, single active session, monotonic elapsed and durable date; restart preserves all-day usage and accepted failure tolerance is up to 300 s.

known_risks.risk: Gateway unavailable cannot itself enforce game stop.
known_risks.mitigation: Active scope accepts up to 300s emergency tolerance; use the existing Bridge loop/supervisor restart, proposed persisted child-session lease around 120s and Gateway checkpoints around 30–60s, preserve all-day usage across restart, and stop only the exact child session.
